desc: The Swedge Fixed Blade Knife with a 4.3" blade features full-tang construction, where the blade extends through the handle, providing superior stability and balance. The blade is crafted from stainless steel, guaranteeing corrosion resistance and edge retention, even in the harshest conditions. The ergonomically designed handle of the Swedge ensures a secure and comfortable grip, minimizing the risk of slippage even during prolonged use. Constructed from rugged materials, it can withstand rough handling and extreme environments without compromising its performance. Includes sheath.
